description: Read the text of a born-digital PDF (one made by software: invoices, statements, reports, contracts, forms), page by page, in reading order, plus any tables found from the text layout as rows of cells. Scanned PDFs (images of pages) have no text layer and come back listed in pages_without_text: OCR is not supported. Set include_lines to also get each line with its position in PDF points from the bottom-left of the page as the viewer sees it, the same frame pdf_edit uses, so you can stamp text next to something you found. Up to 200 pages per call; pass pages to read a large document in parts. To search for specific text instead, use pdf_find_text. Read-only: the source is never modified.

include_lines.description: Also return every line of text with x, y, width and font size in points. Default false (smaller output).

pages.description: Pages to read, 1-based: "1-3,5,8-". Default: all pages.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

tables_format.description: csv adds a csv string (RFC 4180, CRLF line ends) to each table next to rows. Default json. Cell values are returned verbatim: a cell starting with = + - or @ can run as a formula if the CSV is opened in a spreadsheet, so sanitise before opening.

name: pdf_extract_text
title: Extract text and tables from a PDF
